evidence.detail: SeasonInfoDescription is a TypedDict — still present in current master
RawDeckDescription is a TypedDict — still present
CardDescription is a TypedDict used to type parsed JSON from external API — dataclass conversion here requires instantiation code for every JSON parse site
WISDateType, WISSetInfoType, WISSchemaType are TypedDicts typing external JSON — converting to dataclasses adds overhead with no type-safety gain at those boundaries
11 files with TypedDict usages found; mix of internal data structures (convertible) and API-response annotations (less appropriate to convert)

triage.notes: The issue comments themselves debate whether this is worth doing (performance concerns, Container comparison). API-response TypedDicts in magic/fetcher.py and magic/abc/card_description.py are more appropriate as TypedDicts than dataclasses; owner judgment needed on scope.
